g.text: US-05: Proximity Detection - No Prior Relationship Check via Neo4j
Single traversal - not a table scan.
(see graph-update diagram for full idempotency detail)
It writes proximity evidence to Neo4j.
Alert emission belongs to the Alert Evaluator
all alert output from one place.
Alert Evaluator - runs on its own independent evaluation cycle
Completely separate from the Correlation Worker.
Polls Neo4j on each evaluation cycle
Idempotent write - safe under Kafka replay.
